title: Compose and publish Liberty Stomp: a halftime brass Big Beat score

comments.author: home
comments.text: Composed, rendered, measured (objective_v2 96.63), and published Liberty Stomp (scr_scores_Liberty Stomp_apr) using 1890s Sousa brass, march drums, and tuba stems clustered via CLAP semantic search with a stomping halftime break.

right_now_summary: Liberty Stomp has been composed, rendered, measured, and published as a halftime brass Big Beat score.
